methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 ring lights for content creation, streaming, and video: Neewer RL-18 (kit), Neewer RP18B Pro, Neewer RH10B, Elgato Ring Light, Razer Ring Light 12, Lume Cube Ring Light 18, Lume Cube Cordless Ring Light Pro, Godox LR150, Weeylite WE-9, Joby Beamo Ring Light 12, and Mountdog 18-inch. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (neewer.com, elgato.com, lumecube.com, godox.us, joby.com), official tech-spec/support articles (help.elgato.com, mysupport.razer.com), and major resellers (bhphotovideo.com, focuscamera.com, mojocameras.com, impulsecameras.com, amazon.com). priceUsd reflects the US MSRP or lowest published retail price verified at a primary source or major reseller; discontinued/EOL products show last known published price; out-of-stock items with no current published USD price are null. Booleans for phone_holder_included mean the item ships in-box with the ring light kit as tested. accessedAt 2026-06-19. ADVERSARIAL PASS: corrected Razer Ring Light price (was $129; Razer/Walmart MSRP is $99.99 and Best Buy listing was a sale). All other prices and headline specs confirmed against primary sources; all 11 products confirmed to exist.

products.name: Neewer RL-18 18" Ring Light Kit
products.priceNote: Kit with stand; sale price (regular $139.99), neewer.com

specs.color_temp_range_k: 5600 K (fixed, color filters included for 3200 K / 5600 K)

products.provenance: Verified directly on neewer.com product page (slug 66600024): outer diameter 18 in / 45 cm, total power 55 W, CRI 95, 5600 K base with orange/white color filters, AC adapter, stand max height 61 in / 155 cm (folded 29.5 in), and $119.99 sale price (regular $139.99). Kit includes 360-degree rotatable phone holder, stand, filters, Bluetooth remote receiver, and carry bag.

products.name: Neewer RP18B Pro 18" Ring Light Kit
products.provenance: Fetched neewer.com product page directly: 18 in, Max Power 45 W, 2900–7000 K, CRI 97+ / TLCI 98, AC adapter (DC 15V/4A; 110-240 V input), stand 27.2–61.4 in / 69–156 cm, flexible phone holder (fits 6.5–9.5 cm) included. Price $149.99 sale / $169.99 regular confirmed on Neewer page.

products.name: Neewer RH10B 10" Bi-Color Ring Light Kit
products.provenance: Fetched neewer.com product page: 10 in model designation (12 in / 25 cm physical lighting area), 20 W, 2900–7000 K, CRI 97+ / TLCI 98+, USB-powered via included USB-C cable and adapter, stand 21–71 in / 54–180 cm, 360-degree rotatable phone holder included. Price $89.99 confirmed on Neewer page.

products.name: Elgato Ring Light
products.priceNote: Last published MSRP per elgato.com; product marked discontinued / no longer available
products.provenance: Elgato product page confirmed: outer diameter 43.2 cm / 17 in (inner 31 cm / 12.2 in), 2900–7000 K adjustable, up to 45 W, CRI >94% (recorded as floor value 94), 2500 lumens, Wi-Fi app control, desk clamp arm, phone holder included. Page explicitly marks the product 'Discontinued / no longer available, no direct replacement.' Last published price $79.99 per elgato.com; some third-party resellers list higher ($199+) on remaining stock.

products.name: Razer Ring Light 12"
products.priceNote: MSRP $99.99 (Razer / Walmart); frequently discounted at Best Buy and Amazon
products.provenance: Razer official support spec page (RZ19-03660) confirmed: outer diameter 11.8 in / 30.0 cm (marketed as 12"), 10 W, USB-powered (5V 2A for max output), three presets 3000/4500/6500 K, CRI >80% (recorded as floor 80), 500 lumens, tripod 15.8–53.2 in / 40–135 cm, mobile phone holder included. CORRECTED priceUsd 129 -> 99.99: Razer/Walmart list MSRP is $99.99; the cited Best Buy listing was a sale (seen as low as $29.99), and no source supports $129.

products.name: Lume Cube Ring Light 18"
products.provenance: Fetched lumecube.com product page: 18 in, 3200–5600 K, CRI 96+, AC-powered (also accepts Sony NP-F batteries sold separately), 448 LEDs / 528 lumens / 900 lux at 0.5 m, stand up to 6.5 ft (78 in), smartphone mount included. Wattage not published on product page; null rather than guess. Price $135.99 sale / $159.99 regular confirmed on page.

products.name: Lume Cube Cordless Ring Light Pro
products.priceNote: MSRP (sale $254.99 at time of check), lumecube.com
products.provenance: Fetched lumecube.com product page: 17.5 in, 2700–7500 K, CRI 96+, built-in rechargeable Li-ion battery (up to 70 min at full power, up to 120 min at lower output) plus AC adapter, stand 18–70 in, rotating smartphone mount included. Wattage not published; null used. MSRP $299.99 confirmed on page (sale $254.99 active at access time).

products.name: Godox LR150 18" Bi-Color LED Ring Light
products.priceNote: List price, godox.us (light only; stand sold in kit)
products.provenance: godox.us official spec table confirmed 18 in ring (15 in output area), color temperature 2700K~6500K, CRI Average ≥96 / TLCI Average ≥98, AC-powered (DC 24 V / 2A adapter), integrated phone holder, $59.00 list price. Focus Camera reseller confirms 38 W. Note: some Amazon kit listings show a narrower 3000–6000 K marketing range, but godox.us official spec (2700–6500 K) is used. Stand height 25.6–70 in from kit listings.

products.name: Weeylite WE-9 10.4" RGB Ring Light
products.priceNote: Regular US retail price (IMPULSE Cameras / Mojo Cameras $74.99; B&H also carries)
products.provenance: Specs confirmed across cameralk, B&H, and reseller listings: 10.4 in, 12 W (8 W on battery), 2500–8500 K CCT plus full RGB, CRI 95 / TLCI 97, built-in 3700 mAh USB-C rechargeable battery (~80 min runtime), 132 RGB LED beads, smartphone bracket included, 29 scene effects. Only a small desktop bracket ships (no full tripod/stand height published) so stand_height_in null. Price $74.99 regular confirmed at IMPULSE Cameras (sale $52.49) and Mojo Cameras.

products.name: Joby Beamo Ring Light 12"
products.priceNote: MSRP per Adorama / retailer listings (often discounted to ~$33); no stand included
products.provenance: Confirmed across Joby, B&H, Amazon and Amateur Photographer review: 12 in, 12 W, USB Type-A powered (5V/2A, cable with in-line control), three CCT presets 3000/4000/5600 K, CRI 85, 400 lumens. Sold without stand or phone clamp; four cold-shoe mounts for optional Joby accessories, so phone_holder_included false and stand_height_in null. MSRP $44.95 (Adorama lists; on sale ~$33.84 at access time).
